title: Everyday banking
summary: Checking and savings that do the boring parts properly: no monthly fee, early direct deposit and a balance you can trust.
detail: Everyday Checking carries no monthly service fee and no minimum. Pay is available up to two days early when your employer files it early. Savings sits at 4.35% APY with no tiers to chase and no introductory rate that quietly expires.
points: No monthly service fee and no minimum balance
Direct deposit up to two days early
Instant sends to anyone with a US bank account

title: Saving and growth
summary: High-yield savings, money market and certificates, insured to the FDIC limit and priced without games.
detail: Round-ups sweep spare change into a goal you name. Certificates run from three months to five years and pay interest monthly rather than at maturity, so the money is doing something either way.

title: Cards and credit
summary: A debit card you can freeze in a tap and a credit card that pays 2% on everything without a category calendar.
detail: Freeze and unfreeze instantly, set your own daily limits, and turn international or online use on and off. Report a card lost and a replacement goes out the same day, with the new number available to spend online immediately.
points: Freeze, unfreeze and set limits instantly

title: Payments and transfers
summary: ACH, domestic and international wires, bill pay and instant sends, each with a receipt you can quote down a phone line.
detail: Every payment carries a confirmation number, and every ACH an actual trace number, so when something goes missing the receiving bank has something to search on. Outgoing payments to a new recipient are reviewed before they leave.
points: Trace numbers and IMAD references on every wire

title: Business banking
summary: Operating accounts, payroll files, merchant settlement and a treasury team that answers the phone.
detail: Business checking with transaction allowances that suit a real operating rhythm, dual approval on outgoing payments, and role-based access so a bookkeeper can reconcile without being able to move money.
points: Role-based access for staff and bookkeepers

title: Borrowing
summary: Mortgages, auto loans and lines of credit, underwritten by people who will explain the answer either way.
detail: Pre-approval in one business day on most applications, with a named underwriter you can reach. Rates are posted publicly and do not move between quote and close without a documented reason.
points: A named underwriter on every file

title: Security and fraud
summary: Two-step verification, alerts that arrive in seconds and a fraud line that is open every hour of the year.
detail: Sign-ins, payments and profile changes each raise an alert. Anything unusual on an outgoing payment is held for review before it leaves rather than recovered afterwards, which is the only version of that job that actually works.
points: Two-step verification on sign-in and payments
Alerts within seconds of money moving
A fraud line open every hour of the year

title: Wealth and retirement
summary: IRAs, brokerage referrals and a planner who will tell you when you do not need one.
detail: Traditional and Roth IRAs opened alongside your everyday accounts, with contributions automated out of checking and a yearly review that is a conversation rather than a sales call.
